dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: Orchestration rigorously established governance boundaries starting with rules-context-loader. Every downstream span (agentic/structural extraction, proposals, scope classifier, promotion workflow, and 7 reference architecture generators) adhered strictly to schema contracts, achieving 100% schema validation success across all 13 reasoning spans.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: A coherent causal progression was maintained throughout the pattern lifecycle: from rule context loading and dual-track pattern extraction to proposal synthesis, classification, promotion workflow recommendation, and multi-faceted reference architecture generation.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: The trace effectively evaluated and resolved structural and agentic pattern proposals across scope classification and promotion stages, concluding with modular, validated reference architectures that balance systemic flexibility with governance rigor.
